rationale: Only explicit CLOSED status in the matching completed analysis is counted as fixed. Reviewed-safe status requires an individual recorded review with matching issue ID, file, rule and REVIEWED status. Missing and open findings remain pending.

baselineDispositions.rationale: MD5 derives a deterministic non-secret service ID from the service name. It is not a password, signature, authentication token or integrity check. Retaining it preserves persisted service references.

baselineDispositions.rationale: The MessageCard @context is a schema identifier, not a network transport destination. The webhook URL is supplied separately. Retaining the identifier preserves Teams MessageCard compatibility.
tests: NotificationManager regression tests passed; inspected the MessageCard payload and outbound webhook target.
